visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, sits at a table with a white and grey checkered tablecloth. Behind him is a warm-toned wooden bookshelf filled with books and a small warm lamp. Yellow bold text overlays the top of the frame. He gestures with open palms, moving his hands energetically to emphasize his speech. (2) The man points toward his face while a numerical graphic 'No.3' and a question about zebra crossings appear as text. An image of a stylized zebra crossing is superimposed. (3) The scene shifts to a compilation of clips: pedestrians in various costumes and everyday clothes crossing streets on black-and-white zebra lines. One clip shows a white car making a left turn and colliding with a pedestrian. The man in the white shirt is occasionally visible in a smaller window or returns to full screen, looking serious. (4) The man holds a small-scale architectural model of a road with a yellow and black pedestrian refuge island. He uses his hands to point out the features of the model against the same bookshelf background. (5) A technical research paper is displayed on screen, titled 'Methods to Reduce Traffic Speed in High-Pedestrian Areas'. Specific sentences about rural vs urban fatality rates are highlighted in yellow. (6) Aerial drone footage and dashcam clips show cars traveling on wide roads and through intersections. Digital tracking circles and speed metrics (56.3 km/h, 47.5 km/h) are overlaid to show data analysis. (7) Technical diagrams of road engineering standards appear, showing top-down views of intersections with measurements like '1.5m' and '25m' marked in red and yellow. (8) The man returns to the main frame, speaking directly to the camera with high facial expressiveness. He points his index fingers downward at the end, coinciding with a prompt to 'look here'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 那些我們可能都搞錯的交通科學. [Slogan]: No. 3. (2) [Subtitle]: 有斑馬線就夠安全?!. (3) [Subtitle]: 腳踏黑白相間的斑馬線. (4) [Subtitle]: 看似是行人專屬空間. (5) [Subtitle]: 感覺很安全. (6) [Subtitle]: 但其實我們心知肚明. (7) [Subtitle]: 斑馬線根本無法阻止. (8) [Subtitle]: 分心、只踩油門的汽車駕駛. (9) [Subtitle]: 不只在台灣，世界各國的十字路口. (10) [Subtitle]: 每天都在上演這樣的悲劇. (11) [Subtitle]: 難道要穿安全氣囊上路嗎. (12) [Subtitle]: 不，行人庇護島才是真正有效的防護. (13) [Subtitle]: 當然它不是用來硬碰硬. (14) [Subtitle]: 把汽車駕駛擊落的. (15) [Subtitle]: 2000年到2001年. (16) [Subtitle]: 一項在美國明尼蘇達的研究做了實驗. (17) [Subtitle]: 他們要解決的問題是. (18) [Subtitle]: 鄉村行人車禍致死率是都市的3倍. (19) [Subtitle]: 就因為車速太快. (20) [Subtitle]: 研究方法是事前事後對照. (21) [Subtitle]: 先測量介入前的車速. (22) [Subtitle]: 然後在庇護島裝了2周跟6周之後再來測. (23) [Subtitle]: 為了避免數據失真. (24) [Subtitle]: 他們只分析跟前車距離5秒以上. (25) [Subtitle]: 可以自由流動的車. (26) [Subtitle]: 排除掉只是跟車的駕駛. (27) [Subtitle]: 第一組直接在路中間放行人庇護島. (28) [Subtitle]: 再搭配行人穿越道的標誌. (29) [Subtitle]: 把路縮小營造壓力. (30) [Subtitle]: 結果超有效！平均車速從. (31) [Subtitle]: 時速約56.3公里，降到時速約47.5公里. (32) [Subtitle]: 守法率從30%提高到58%. (33) [Subtitle]: 第二組用電子看板. (34) [Subtitle]: 你要是超速它就閃 SLOW. (35) [Subtitle]: 結果呢？完全失敗. (36) [Subtitle]: 駕駛根本不鳥. (37) [Subtitle]: 長期下來車速反而還上升. (38) [Subtitle]: 所以物理路障的確有效. (39) [Subtitle]: 但之所以有效，是因為駕駛不能直接切西瓜. (40) [Subtitle]: 必須開超過路口的一半才能打方向盤. (41) [Subtitle]: 速度自動會慢下來. (42) [Subtitle]: 還有啊，許多弱勢行人根本來不及一次過完綠燈. (43) [Subtitle]: 被迫停在馬路中央，冒著左右車流的風險. (44) [Subtitle]: 但有了庇護島，他們就能選擇. (45) [Subtitle]: 停在安全區域，等待下一次綠燈. (46) [Subtitle]: 既然有效就要做. (47) [Subtitle]: 針對行人穿越量較大的市區道路路口. (48) [Subtitle]: 內政部定有「市區道路及附屬工程設計規範」. (49) [Subtitle]: 交通部也有「交通工程規範」. (50) [Subtitle]: 兩者都有要求，當行人穿越道長度超過25公尺時. (51) [Subtitle]: 就應設置庇護島. (52) [Subtitle]: 而且庇護島的寬度建議要有1.5公尺. (53) [Subtitle]: 還需要設置反光島標、路中障礙物線等相關安全設施. (54) [Subtitle]: 提醒駕駛注意. (55) [Subtitle]: 加了庇護島數據真的變好. (56) [Subtitle]: 交通部公路局2024年總共完成. (57) [Subtitle]: 2978處的省道路口改善. (58) [Subtitle]: 調整352處的行穿線增設庇護島. (59) [Subtitle]: 還有增設或調整333處的行人號誌. (60) [Subtitle]: 統計到2025年6月，已經完成改善的路口發生A1事故. (61) [Subtitle]: 也就是24小時內有人死亡的事故. (62) [Subtitle]: 月平均件數下降了43.38%. (63) [Subtitle]: 有人受傷的A2事故，月平均件數也下降了7.83%. (64) [Subtitle]: 代表改善已經發揮效果了，讚啦！. (65) [Subtitle]: 然而只加個行人庇護島還不夠. (66) [Subtitle]: 現實是事故雖然變少但還在發生. (67) [Subtitle]: 那還能怎麼辦呢？來看看芬蘭吧. (68) [Subtitle]: 他們首都赫爾辛基，竟然一整年沒有任何交通死亡案例. (69) [Subtitle]: 好到不可思議. (70) [Subtitle]: 他們做對了哪4件事？怎麼做的？快點這裡來看看吧.
